# Vendored third-party code

## three.module.js

* **Package:** [three](https://www.npmjs.com/package/three) `0.160.1`
* **Obtained with:** `npm pack three@0.160.1` → `package/build/three.module.js`
* **Licence:** MIT © 2010–2023 three.js authors — see `LICENSE-three.txt`
* **Modifications:** none. The file is byte-identical to the published build.

It is vendored rather than loaded from a CDN so that the game has no network
dependency at runtime: open `index.html` from any static server (or a local
file server) and it works offline, forever, at a fixed version.

Nothing else in this project is third-party. All geometry, textures, shaders,
icons, maps and audio are generated by the code in `src/`.
